# संRACHNA - GEC Godda
> The Official Annual College Magazine of Government Engineering College, Godda.

This website showcases the official college magazine "संRACHNA". It features student achievements, technical articles, cultural events, and institutional innovations from GEC Godda.

Key Details:
- Institution: Government Engineering College (GEC), Godda
- Topic: Annual College Magazine
- Features: 3D animations, interactive reading experience
